title: Italian Creamy Chwinamul Casserole
description: A creamy, comforting Italian-inspired casserole featuring chwinamul as the star ingredient.
instructions: Cook the casserole slices in a pan with olive oil until golden brown.
In a separate saucepan, make a bechamel sauce with the creamy sauce.
Add the sliced chwinamul to the bechamel sauce and cook until softened.
In a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, arrange a layer of cooked casserole.
Top with a layer of the chwinamul and bechamel sauce mixture.
Repeat the layers one more time, finishing with a layer of bechamel sauce.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is hot and bubbly.
Let it rest for a few minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
